extracted.intended_audience: students and coaches preparing for mathematics olympiads (high-school contest participants and trainers)
extracted.subtask_description: An index of handouts and short guides by Evan Chen covering proof-writing, problem writing, topic primers (geometry, inequalities, combinatorics, number theory), contest analyses, and practical advice for olympiad participants and coaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beginner's page
rubrics_metrics.description: I suggest reading through the beginner’s page first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A starting guide for newcomers to the olympiad scene; linked as primary orientation material for beginners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes on proof-writing style
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes on proof-writing style. These were used at MOP in 2016, later updated March 2020 and December 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to write mathematical proofs (style advice). Available as English pdf and git sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: From the Author’s Side: Thoughts on Problem Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: A short philosophical blurb about writing problems for math olympiads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice aimed at problem writers about the principles and philosophies behind creating olympiad problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intro to Proofs for the Morbidly Curious
rubrics_metrics.description: An excessively long description of how mathematical proofs work in theory and in practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A deep, conceptual account of proofs intended to teach proof structure and reasoning for contest-level problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unofficial syllabus for math olympiads
rubrics_metrics.description: Rough informal guidance on what topics appear on math olympiads, for people who are new to the scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic coverage recommendations and expectations for contest preparation (an informal syllabus).

rubrics_metrics.name: IMO 2014 Journal
rubrics_metrics.description: This describes my experiences competing as TWN2 at the 55th IMO 2014.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contest journal including personal reflections; may contain insights into problem selection and solving approaches from a competitor's perspective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taiwan TST 2014 Reflection
rubrics_metrics.description: This describes my experiences competing for a position on the Taiwan IMO 2014 team. It also contains an extensive commentary on each of the Team Selection Tests and Quizzes, which together covered most of the 2013 IMO Shortlist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-contest reflections and detailed commentary on selection tests useful for understanding selection criteria and problem difficulty.

rubrics_metrics.name: USAMO 2014 Contest Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: This describes in detail the thought process behind each of my solutions to the USAMO 2014. I also scanned the solutions I submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed solution writeups demonstrating approaches and reasoning; useful as exemplars of high-quality contest solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Functional Equations
rubrics_metrics.description: An introduction to functional equations for olympiad students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic primer covering techniques and examples for solving functional equations in olympiad problems. An updated version appears in OTIS Excerpts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lagrange Multipliers Done Correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of the conditions necessary to execute a Lagrange Multipliers solution on an olympiad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical checklist/conditions and correct application procedures for using Lagrange multipliers in contest inequality/optimization problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monsters
rubrics_metrics.description: A handout discussing pathological functional equations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers atypical or pathological examples in functional equations and strategies to handle them; updated material appears in OTIS Excerpts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Olympiad Inequalities
rubrics_metrics.description: English translation of my original notes in Chinese. Describes some 'standard strategies' for handling olympiad inequalities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey of common inequality techniques and standard strategic patterns to apply in contest settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOS: A Dumbass’s Perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the SOS method for solving inequalities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explanation and worked examples of the Sum-of-Squares method (strategy-focused guide).

rubrics_metrics.name: Summation
rubrics_metrics.description: General discussion of sums and products, and how to deal with them. Includes generating functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Techniques and strategies for handling summation expressions and generating functions in contest problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected Uses of Probability
rubrics_metrics.description: Inspired by Po-Shen Loh’s talk at the 55th IMO 2014 on Problem 6. Talks about expected value and the probabilistic method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exposition on when and how to apply expectation and probabilistic methods in olympiad combinatorics/probability problems. (Also appeared in Mathematical Reflections.)

rubrics_metrics.name: A Guessing Game: Mixtilinear Incircles
rubrics_metrics.description: A quick description of some nice properties of mixtilinear incircles. Presented as a 'guessing game' where one has to guess collinear points, cyclic quadrilaterals, and so on beforehand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A guided exploration format to build intuition on mixtilinear incircles and recognizing common configurations in geometry problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Barycentric Coordinates in Olympiad Geometry
rubrics_metrics.description: One of my most famous handouts from 2012. Introduces from scratch the method of barycentric coordinates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A tutorial on using barycentric coordinates in olympiad geometry problems; includes full and abridged versions and served as basis for a textbook chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bashing Geometry with Complex Numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: English translation of my original notes in Chinese. Describes the classic method of complex numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technique-focused guide showing how to apply complex numbers algebraically to geometry problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constructing Diagrams
rubrics_metrics.description: A handout on advice for drawing diagrams on geometry problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical tips on how to draw accurate and informative diagrams that help discovery and exposition in geometry solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Use Directed Angles
rubrics_metrics.description: A short note on the use of directed angles in olympiad solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise rules and conventions for applying directed angles, with cross-reference to FAQ C-11.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lemmas in AoPS Geometry
rubrics_metrics.description: A sardonically named handout that lists some silly names in olympiad geometry popular culture on the Internet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultural/terminology notes about common lemma names and conventions encountered on AoPS; may inform presentation/style rather than technical content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Olympiad GeoGuessr
rubrics_metrics.description: A simple online game where you can practice looking for collinear or concyclic points in diagrams from real MO-style problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An interactive practice tool for developing visual pattern recognition and configuration spotting in geometry diagrams.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Incenter/Excenter Lemma
rubrics_metrics.description: A collection of problems which exhibit the first olympiad configuration I got to know well, the famous 'incenter/excenter lemma'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Problem set showcasing a specific geometry configuration and typical uses—serves as a focused practice module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Olympiad Geometry Problems
rubrics_metrics.description: For students who are interested in writing their own olympiad geometry problems! Or more generally, anyone who is curious how my geometry problems get created.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on the process and principles behind composing olympiad-level geometry problems (problem-writing advice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Orders Modulo a Prime
rubrics_metrics.description: Article on orders and primitive roots, in particular featuring the sum of squares lemma and its generalization to arbitrary cyclotomic polynomials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number-theory primer focusing on multiplicative order techniques useful in olympiad problems; updated version appears in OTIS Excerpts.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Chinese Remainder Theorem
rubrics_metrics.description: An article on the Chinese Remainder 'Theorem'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exposition of CRT techniques and applications for contest problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chinese Terminology Sheet
rubrics_metrics.description: These are the notes that I took when I was studying traditional Chinese in preparation for the Taiwan IMO selection and training camps. It is updated occasionally as I add entries. I use traditional characters, but you can also find a version with simplified characters too.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Language/terminology reference useful for competitors involved in Chinese-language contest settings or translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: EXCL 2023: Thoughts and Q/A on math olympiad coaching
rubrics_metrics.description: Slides from a talk I gave in November 2023 about experiences with coaching students for math olympiads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coach-focused reflections and practical advice on running training programs and mentoring contest students.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to annoy Evan with LaTeX
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of pet peeves in LaTeX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style and formatting anti-patterns to avoid when preparing LaTeX submissions; links to Evan’s LaTeX style guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: LaTeX Example File
rubrics_metrics.description: A short document which shows what a 'typical' LaTeX file looks like. It was written for beginners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical example file to teach correct LaTeX project structure and formatting conventions for contest writeups.

rubrics_metrics.name: OMO Spring 2014 Executive Report
rubrics_metrics.description: A short report on running the Online Math Open for Spring 2014. This is mostly for the sake of those who will be running the future installments of the contest, as one of us is graduating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational guidance and lessons learned for contest organizers running an online math contest.

rubrics_metrics.name: USAMO 2003 Rubric
rubrics_metrics.description: The grading rubric for USAMO 2003.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An explicit contest grading rubric (linked as pdf and source repo) – a concrete example of scoring standards for an olympiad exam.
